title: Utilities Engineer – Civil Infrastructure
abstract: Utilities Engineer supporting identification, investigation, design and coordination of utility infrastructure on major infrastructure projects.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a Utilities Engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
Do you have Engineering Drawing Interpretation experience?
content_text:
About the role
IEG is seeking a Utilities Engineer to join our growing NSW team. This role will suit an engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and working across multiple engineering disciplines. You will support the identification, investigation, design and coordination of utility infrastructure affected by major civil works. You will work with experienced utilities specialists on projects involving water, sewer, stormwater, electrical, telecommunications and gas infrastructure. The role provides exposure to the complete project lifecycle, from tender and early contractor involvement through to detailed design and construction delivery.
Key responsibilities
- Supporting the identification and assessment of existing utility infrastructure
- Reviewing utility records, surveys, BYDA information, design documentation and subsurface utility investigation results
- Preparing and maintaining utility registers, interface registers, clash reports, risk assessments and design documentation
- Coordinating utility investigations, including survey, service locating and potholing activities
- Developing utility adjustment, protection and relocation solutions
- Reviewing civil designs to identify utility conflicts, constructability constraints and project risks
- Coordinating with civil, structural, electrical, drainage, traffic and construction teams
- Liaising with utility authorities, clients, contractors, surveyors and specialist designers
- Supporting authority consultation, design submissions and approval processes
- Contributing to utility management plans, services management plans, technical reports, scopes of work and cost estimates
About you
- A recognised degree in civil engineering or a related engineering discipline
- Experience in utilities engineering, civil infrastructure design, utility coordination or construction delivery
- An understanding of underground and overhead utility infrastructure
- The ability to interpret civil drawings, utility plans, survey information and technical specifications
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- A practical approach to engineering and problem-solving
- Good attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities
- The confidence to communicate with clients, contractors, designers and utility authorities
- A collaborative attitude and willingness to take ownership of your work
- A current Australian driver licence
About us
Infrastructure Engineering Group (IEG) is a specialist engineering design and advisory consultancy supporting the delivery of major infrastructure and energy projects across Australia. Established in 2021, we have built a strong reputation for practical engineering, responsive service and high-quality outcomes. Our team works closely with Tier 1 and Tier 2 contractors, government agencies, utility authorities and design partners across major road, rail, energy and urban infrastructure projects. Our values of Integrity, Excellence, Ownership and Trust guide how we work with our clients and each other.
